clips.name: ball_roll_left
clips.notes: ball roll from standing: right sole rolls the ball 0.6 m to his left, support-foot hop, exit to the left-forward

clips.name: ball_roll_right
clips.notes: ball roll from standing: right sole rolls the ball 0.6 m to his left, support-foot hop, exit to the left-forward

clips.name: ball_roll_left_run
clips.notes: ball roll at a run: right sole rolls the ball about 0.85 m to his left while he runs on at 85% of his pace and steps 0.5 m with it, the left foot skipping under him in two small hops, facing along the run; the left foot stands under him for the right foot's exit touch

clips.name: ball_roll_right_run
clips.notes: ball roll at a run: right sole rolls the ball about 0.85 m to his left while he runs on at 85% of his pace and steps 0.5 m with it, the left foot skipping under him in two small hops, facing along the run; the left foot stands under him for the right foot's exit touch

clips.name: ball_roll_left_run_swap
clips.notes: ball roll at a run, ending for an exit touch made by the support foot: the left foot leaves the ground at the second hop's take-off and swings into the touch; the right foot comes off the ball down onto the pitch as the new support

clips.name: ball_roll_right_run_swap
clips.notes: ball roll at a run, ending for an exit touch made by the support foot: the left foot leaves the ground at the second hop's take-off and swings into the touch; the right foot comes off the ball down onto the pitch as the new support

clips.name: body_feint_left
clips.notes: body feint from standing: hard wide plant and deep lunge to the left, shoulder and hip drop with the right arm across, push off the left foot to the right

clips.name: body_feint_right
clips.notes: body feint from standing: hard wide plant and deep lunge to the left, shoulder and hip drop with the right arm across, push off the left foot to the right

clips.name: body_feint_left_run
clips.notes: body feint at a run: two short steps, a wide hard plant and lunge left, shoulder drop, off the plant to the right; the left foot makes the exit touch (the right in the _swap ending)

clips.name: body_feint_right_run
clips.notes: body feint at a run: two short steps, a wide hard plant and lunge left, shoulder drop, off the plant to the right; the left foot makes the exit touch (the right in the _swap ending)

clips.name: body_feint_left_run_swap
clips.notes: body feint at a run, ending for an exit touch made by the right foot: the left skips off the plant to his right and stands under him, the right swings into the ball

clips.name: body_feint_right_run_swap
clips.notes: body feint at a run, ending for an exit touch made by the right foot: the left skips off the plant to his right and stands under him, the right swings into the ball
